name: Review and prepare tasks
description: Two participants reconcile code findings in up to 10 rounds, then prepare a selectable task checklist without modifying the repository. This workflow does not implement the tasks.

steps.name: Converge
steps.promptTemplate:
Cross-reference the complete peer answer with repository evidence. Return JSON only with candidate, accepted, objections, and unresolvedRisks. candidate must be {"findings":[...]}. Each finding needs stable id, subject, message, explicit disposition accepted/rejected/unresolved, evidence and challenges string arrays, optional severity error/warning/information, and optional location with file/startLine/endLine. accepted is boolean for this exact candidate. Keep proposed claims out of accepted findings.

{{peerAnswer}}

steps.name: Prepare execution checklist
steps.promptTemplate:
Convert the accepted result into concise execution issues. Keep only confirmed work inside the original request. Preserve dependencies and paths. Do not produce commands. Do not add new scope.

{{previousStepAnswers}}
